description: The valid framework agreements (`ata de registro de preços`) on PNCP for the object, most relevant first: the managing agency, the validity, whether the agreement accepts joining (carona) and the link to the agreement. Free. Only the agreements that are not canceled and are valid today or later. `adesao=1` returns only the ones that accept joining. The procurement record (`/api/compra/:id`) has the agreements that it generated. `Accept: text/html` opens the Atas vigentes tab with the terms.

adesao.description: 1 for only the agreements that accept joining (optional).

name: framework_agreements
title: Valid framework agreements
